title: 第六章 来了
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
“哟呵，到位了老铁，虽说不是同一个钟点，但绝对是同一片后山，开整吧兄弟们!“

    手攥铁铲，季南北迈步进了后山。

    眼下天色已晚，林子里依稀能见月光从枝叶间隙漏下来，洒在泥地上。

    一阵凉风打着旋儿掠过去。

    还真有点阴森森的味道。

    不过季南北压根没理会周遭气氛，这小子正亢奋着呢，一路往前去，时不时还甩两下手里那柄铲子，好像随时准备给谁来一记当头暴击。

    快活林魔宗周边的山林倒是照旧安静。

    季南北难得瞧见一只野兔子，却也没打算动它。

    这趟出来，季南北可有更宏大的计划!

    拎着铲子，季南北踏进了以往从未涉足的林子深处。

    之前在外围转悠那会儿，季南北瞥见过一头体格特大的灰毛狼形妖兽。

    那家伙浑身冒着一股凶悍气息，季南北敢断定它绝不是寻常野兽，绝对是妖兽，起码抵得上练气二层三层的实力。

    估计是追捕猎物，才跑到快活林魔宗附近来的。

    当时季南北自觉没胜算，扭头就撤回了宗门里。

    这回季南北的目标，正是那头妖狼。

    正往前探着路，系统界面冷不丁弹了出来。

    [触发强敌讨伐任务，请从以下三项中选取一条，并完成本次讨伐。]

    选择一：向左转走三千步，向下挖掘三尺，即可完成讨伐。(奖赏：两百万魔道点数，七阶珍宝“阴阳两仪坠“.)

    选择二：笔直前进一千步，右转再走三十步，即可完成讨伐。(奖赏：五万魔道点数，四品灵药“我爱一条柴“.)

    选择三：直行两百步，右转一百步，即可完成讨伐。(奖赏：一千魔道点数，随机三品灵符一张。)

    季南北盯着光幕，整个人都愣住了。

    选项一的奖励比上次对萧京溪自曝身份还丰厚!?我家这后山底下究竟是埋了啥玩意儿啊!

    季南北真是庆幸自己以前还算知道深浅，只在附近刨来刨去，没往深处闯，不然看这奖励架势，怎么没的都不清楚。

    再看第二个选项，好家伙非搞这种调调是吧!?

    好好的四品灵物，居然是瓶媚药!

    这玩意儿能干啥?算计师姐吗?

    季南北赶紧摇头把这危险的念头甩出去。

    总之，选第三个就没错。

    径直走了两百步后，季南北右转，又迈了一百步。

    不多时，一头体长超过两米的灰毛巨狼便映入季南北眼帘。
content_en:
"Oh, we're here, old man. Although it's not the same hour, it's definitely the same back mountain. Let's get started, brothers!"

    Holding the shovel in hand, Ji Nanbei stepped into the back mountain.

    It was getting late now, and the moonlight could be faintly seen leaking through the branches and leaves in the forest and shining on the muddy ground.

    A cool breeze swirled past.

    It has a really spooky flavor.

    However, Ji Nanbei didn't pay attention to the atmosphere around him. This kid was very excited, moving forward, shaking the shovel in his hand from time to time, as if he was ready to hit someone in the head at any time.

    The mountains and forests around Happy Forest Demon Sect are still quiet.

    Ji Nanbei rarely saw a wild rabbit, but he had no intention of touching it.

    This time, Ji Nanbei has a bigger plan!

    Carrying a shovel, Ji Nanbei stepped into the depths of the forest that he had never set foot in before.

    When Ji Nanbei was wandering around the area before, he caught a glimpse of an extremely large gray-furred wolf-shaped monster.

    That guy had a ferocious aura all over his body, and Ji Nanbei dared to conclude that it was no ordinary beast, but definitely a monster, at least as strong as the second and third levels of Qi training.

    It was probably because he was chasing prey that he came near the Happy Forest Demon Sect.

    At that time, Ji Nanbei realized that he had no chance of winning, so he turned around and withdrew to the sect.

    This time Ji Nanbei's target was the demon wolf.

    As he was exploring the way forward, the system interface suddenly popped up.

    [To trigger the powerful enemy crusade mission, please choose one of the following three items and complete this crusade. ]

    Option 1: Turn left, walk three thousand steps, and dig down three feet to complete the crusade. (Reward: Two million magic points, seventh-level treasure "Yin Yang Pendant".)

    Option 2: Go straight forward a thousand steps, turn right and walk another thirty steps to complete the crusade. (Reward: 50,000 magic points, fourth-grade elixir "I Love Ichijo Chai".)

    Option 3: Go straight for 200 steps and turn right for 100 steps to complete the crusade. (Reward: one thousand magic points, a random third-grade talisman.)

    Ji Nanbei stared at the light screen and was stunned.

    The reward for option one is even richer than the last time I exposed my identity to Xiao Jingxi!? What on earth is buried under the mountain behind my house?

    Ji Nanbei was really glad that he knew the depth before and only poked around nearby instead of going deeper. Otherwise, looking at the reward posture, it would be unclear why there was no reward.

    Let’s look at the second option again. You guys have to do this, right?

    A good fourth-grade spiritual object is actually a bottle of love potion!

    What can this thing do? Is it plotting against senior sister?

    Ji Nanbei quickly shook his head to get rid of this dangerous thought.

    In short, you are right to choose the third one.

    After walking straight for two hundred steps, Ji Nanbei turned right and took another hundred steps.

    Not long after, a giant gray wolf with a body length of more than two meters came into view of Ji Nanbei.
